endpoint_scan_policy: Only endpoints documented in official Adaption docs (docs.adaptionlabs.ai) or already used by frozen repository code were registered. No speculative endpoint probing or broad scans were performed.

endpoints.response_shape: object "list" with data[] items {id, created, object, owned_by, display_name?, shutdown_date?}

endpoints.detail: The official Adaption API reference documents no account, billing, or credits-balance resource (datasets/responses/models/tools only). Credits balance is visible in the app console (https://adaptionlabs.ai/app). No speculative endpoint was probed.

execution.note: Run-time counts recorded by the collector: GETs actually issued against the transport allowlist (models + pricing). POST and paid counts are 0 because the paid inference endpoint is unreachable by the allowlist.
